    queue = deque()
    
    # Add all border background cells
    for c in range(width):
        if grid[0][c] != 4:  # top row
            queue.append((0, c))
            visited.add((0, c))
        if grid[height-1][c] != 4:  # bottom row
            queue.append((height-1, c))
            visited.add((height-1, c))
    for r in range(1, height-1):
        if grid[r][0] != 4:  # left col
            queue.append((r, 0))
            visited.add((r, 0))
        if grid[r][width-1] != 4:  # right col
            queue.append((r, width-1))
            visited.add((r, width-1))
    
    # Flood fill
    while queue:
        r, c = queue.popleft()
